arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Falling Star{/c} deals {c_random}[Affix_Value_1|%x|]{/c} increased damage.

Killing an enemy with {c_important}Falling Star{/c} resets its Cooldown and increases its damage by {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 0" * 100|x%|]{/c} for {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 1"]{/c} seconds, stacking up to {c_number}[Affix."Static Value 2"]{/c} times. This effect can only happen once per cast.
